arms.defect: Fit and select the rate on primary hits only (log2fc < -0.5), mimicking D6 coverage
arms.fixed: Add the hidden weak-primary labelled rows back as pseudo-negatives (label False)
arms.fixed_full: The D6 device verbatim: every weak-primary row, labelled or not, as a pseudo-negative
arms.ceiling_screened: Real labels of every screened row, bounding what a weak-primary repair can close
arms.ceiling: Real, complete label set including missing-primary rows
arms.fixed_missing: As fixed_full, but also relabel missing-primary rows False (deliberately wrong)

config.judgement: Real, complete held-fold labels, which no arm except the ceiling ever saw
config.status: Validation-design probe; no candidate, submission or upload
config.mixture_note: Real-label strong and weak strata reweighted to a target strong fraction phi, matching the blind scored composition implied by the 7.06% prevalence identity

caveats: The induced defect mimics D6 coverage; it does not reproduce D6 assay chemistry
One LightGBM recipe is used for every arm; the deployed A4 ensemble is not refitted
1A2 and 2C9 carry 23 and 38 positives, so their intervals are wide by construction
fixed_full trains on unlabelled weak rows whose truth is bounded, not observed
A rate is a fraction of all 6,146 development rows, because calls use complete pools
